design: All10 frozenH852 models; independent single-state learned and fixed-support LS coordinates, each with/without residual-norm calibration. No task direction or gain fitting.
encoding: C=normalizedstate-tokenmean, decoder bias beta. Calibrated C_hat=beta+(C_hat-beta)*norm(C-beta)/norm(C_hat-beta). Preserve mean and restore each states own rawRMS after fullshape normalization. One additional native residual-norm scalar, beyond tokenidentity and rawRMS already accessed. Gates/support unchanged.
causal: Define one raw reconstruction function F(input), then edit native recipient rawstate by F(donor)-F(recipient). This is cycle-consistent before model execution. UnlikeH853/H854, normalize each reconstruction before differencing; compare variants within this experiment. Exact rawdonor is reference.
natural: Same512 H851 development states, reconstruction and four fixed Gaussian localMLP derivative probes fromH851. Reused validation, no fitting.
scope: Reused task panel and naturaldevelopment. Test inference rule, not fresh confirmation or semantic-unit recovery. Single-state mapping preserves recipient reconstruction error under interventions.
